title: Creamy Frittata
description: A rich and creamy frittata, perfect for a weekend brunch.
instructions: In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium heat.
Add diced free and cook until softened.
In a large bowl, whisk together eggs, shredded gooey, american, and a pinch of salt.
Pour the egg mixture over the cooked free in the skillet.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the eggs are set.
While the frittata is baking, heat heavy cream in a small saucepan over low heat.
Once the frittata is done, remove it from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes.
Drizzle the warm heavy cream over the frittata and serve.
